b1-tatarjaras-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Warning
b1-tatarjaras-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you what happened before the Tatar invasion. You say that Friar Julian warned King Béla IV, and that the Tatars were approaching the border.
b1-tatarjaras-01.prompt: Tell the official who warned King Béla IV and what the Tatars were doing.
cues: Say what the Tatars were doing
b1-tatarjaras-01.target: Julianus barát figyelmeztette a királyt a veszedelemre. A tatárok közeledtek a határokhoz.
b1-tatarjaras-01.english: Friar Julian warned the king about the danger. The Tatars were approaching the borders.
b1-tatarjaras-01.canDo: I can describe the approaching Mongol threat in the 1230s and Julianus barát's mission.

b1-tatarjaras-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Battle of Mohi
b1-tatarjaras-02.scenario: At a museum in Muhi, a guide asks you when and where the battle took place and how it ended. You say the royal army suffered a heavy defeat.
b1-tatarjaras-02.prompt: Tell the guide the date of the battle, the river beside it and how it ended.
cues: Say how it ended for the Hungarians
b1-tatarjaras-02.target: A muhi csata 1241. április 11-én volt a Sajó folyónál. A királyi hadsereg súlyos vereséget szenvedett.
b1-tatarjaras-02.english: The battle of Mohi was on 11 April 1241 at the Sajó river. The royal army suffered a heavy defeat.
b1-tatarjaras-02.canDo: I can state the exact date (1241. április 11.) and location (Sajó folyó, Muhi) of the battle.

b1-tatarjaras-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Ruined Country
b1-tatarjaras-03.scenario: In a history class, your teacher asks what happened to the country after the battle. You say that villages burned down and the Danube froze.
b1-tatarjaras-03.prompt: Tell your teacher what happened to the villages and how the Mongols crossed the Danube.
cues: Say what happened to the villages
Say how the Mongols crossed the Danube
b1-tatarjaras-03.target: A falvak felégtek. A Duna télen befagyott, és a mongolok átkeltek a jégen.
b1-tatarjaras-03.english: The villages burned down. The Danube froze in winter, and the Mongols crossed on the ice.
b1-tatarjaras-03.canDo: I can describe the winter crossing of the frozen Danube by the Mongols.

b1-tatarjaras-04.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Mongols Left
b1-tatarjaras-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks what King Béla IV did after the Mongols left. You say he invited settlers and rebuilt the country.
b1-tatarjaras-04.prompt: Tell the official when the Mongols left and what the king did afterwards.
cues: Say what the king did for the country
b1-tatarjaras-04.target: 1242 tavaszán a mongolok kivonultak. IV. Béla telepeseket hívott be, és újjáépítette az országot.
b1-tatarjaras-04.english: In spring 1242 the Mongols withdrew. Béla IV invited settlers and rebuilt the country.
b1-tatarjaras-04.canDo: I can explain why the Mongols abruptly left Hungary in spring 1242.

b1-tatarjaras-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Stone Castles
b1-tatarjaras-05.scenario: At the Buda Castle exhibition, a guide asks what King Béla IV built after the invasion. You say he built stone castles and that the Hungarians resisted in 1285.
b1-tatarjaras-05.prompt: Tell the guide what the king built and what happened when the Tatars came back.
cues: Say what was built instead of the old forts
b1-tatarjaras-05.target: A király kővárakat épített. 1285-ben a tatárok újra betörtek, de a magyarok visszaverték őket.
b1-tatarjaras-05.english: The king built stone castles. In 1285 the Tatars invaded again, but the Hungarians drove them back.
b1-tatarjaras-05.canDo: I can explain why stone castles succeeded against the Mongols where earthworks failed.

b1-tatarjaras-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Whole Story
b1-tatarjaras-consolidation.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you to tell the story of the Tatar invasion in a few sentences: the battle, the destruction and the rebuilding.
b1-tatarjaras-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official in a few sentences what happened at Mohi, to the country, and afterwards.
cues: Say what happened to the country
Say what the king did afterwards
b1-tatarjaras-consolidation.target: 1241-ben a magyar sereg vereséget szenvedett Muhinál. Az ország nagy része romba dőlt. IV. Béla újjáépítette az országot, ezért második honalapítónak nevezik.
b1-tatarjaras-consolidation.english: In 1241 the Hungarian army was defeated at Mohi. Much of the country fell into ruins. Béla IV rebuilt the country, so he is called the second founder of the homeland.
b1-tatarjaras-consolidation.canDo: I can narrate the complete story of the 1241–1242 Tatar invasion (tatárjárás) in chronological order.
